title: 毛毛虫的新衣服
subtitle: 睡一觉，就长出了翅膀
character: wearing an orange t-shirt, green shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration drawn with bright felt-tip markers, bold black outlines, flat vivid colors, simple cheerful shapes, visible marker strokes, the drawing fills the whole picture edge to edge on a plain white background
facts: 蝴蝶小时候的样子，最爱吃叶子
长得太快，旧皮穿不下就换掉
毛毛虫变蝴蝶时住的小房子

pages.zh:
妈妈种的菜叶上，
有好多小洞洞。
是谁咬的呢？
我翻开叶子一看——
pages.scene: In a small vegetable garden, the little boy bends over a big green cabbage leaf full of small holes, lifting the edge of the leaf to peek underneath, curious.

pages.zh:
是一只小小的毛毛虫！
绿绿的，软软的，
一拱一拱地往前爬。
pages.scene: Close up of a small green caterpillar crawling along a big green leaf, its body arched up in the middle as it moves, little holes nibbled in the leaf.

pages.zh:
它一直吃，一直吃，
吃完一片叶子，又吃一片。
身体越来越胖，越来越长。
pages.scene: A fat green caterpillar munching on the edge of a leaf, half of the leaf already eaten away, other leaves around it with bites taken out.

pages.zh:
它长得太快了，
身上的皮都穿不下了。
于是它脱掉旧皮，
换上一件新衣服。
pages.scene: A fresh bright green caterpillar crawls forward along a leaf. Behind it on the leaf lies its old skin, a tiny crumpled pale brown wrinkled husk like a scrunched-up sock.

pages.zh:
有一天，毛毛虫不吃东西了。
它爬到树枝上，
吐出细细的丝，
把自己倒挂了起来。
pages.scene: A green caterpillar hanging upside down from a thin twig by a tiny silk thread, curled into a J shape, soft garden background.

pages.zh:
它把自己包成一个小硬壳，
一动也不动。
这个小房子，叫做「蛹」。
pages.scene: A single smooth green chrysalis hanging still from a twig, with tiny gold dots on it, green leaves around it.

pages.zh:
我每天都去看它。
一天，两天，三天……
它还是一动也不动。
它在里面做什么呢？
pages.scene: The little boy crouches in the garden looking up at a green chrysalis hanging from a twig, chin resting in his hands, waiting patiently, morning light.

pages.zh:
咔——
蛹裂开了一条缝。
钻出来的不是毛毛虫，
是一只皱巴巴的蝴蝶！
pages.scene: A butterfly slowly coming out of a split open chrysalis on a twig, its wings still crumpled and damp, holding on to the empty chrysalis shell.

pages.zh:
它扇扇翅膀，
翅膀慢慢张开了，
又大又漂亮，
还有好多好看的花纹。
pages.scene: A beautiful butterfly resting on a twig with its colorful patterned wings fully open, sunlight, green leaves around.

pages.zh:
蝴蝶飞起来了，
飞到了花园里。
我种下几棵花，
给它留好吃的花蜜。
「你的新衣服真漂亮！」
pages.scene: The little boy plants a small flower in the garden with a little shovel, and a colorful butterfly flutters above the flowers next to him, sunny cheerful day.
